instruction: Please configure VS Code to hide all ".pytest_cache" folders from the file explorer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding .pytest_cache folders in VS Code explorer. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify files.exclude setting contains '**/.pytest_cache': true. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings file from the correct path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly handles the expected parameter when type='rule' - properly accesses expected['expected'] to get the settings dict
Expected value is semantically correct: 'files.exclude' with pattern '**/.pytest_cache': true is the correct VS Code setting to hide .pytest_cache folders from file explorer
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (hide .pytest_cache folders) and evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Runtime feasibility: settings.json persists automatically when user modifies VS Code settings, no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 if JSON parsing fails, if key is missing, or if value doesn't match

metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
